kpis.sub: Q3 2026 PRIVATE SPACE INVESTMENT · RECORD QUARTER
kpis.label: Seraphim counts 216 deals in Q3 (median $9.8M) versus $7.4B in Q2; Blue Origin's $10B round at a reported $130B valuation is nearly half the total — excluding it, the quarter is still $10.8B.

kpis.sub: SPCX ~$149 VS $225.64 JUNE HIGH · LOCKUP SUPPLY AHEAD
kpis.label: SpaceX closed at $148.62 on Oct 15 (−2.3%) after Starshield restrictions in Ukraine drew headlines; it is above the $135 IPO price but far below the June peak, and a further 28% of pre-IPO shares become sellable after Q3 earnings, expected early November.

kpis.sub: NEUTRON FIRST LAUNCH SLIPS AGAIN · OCT 14
kpis.label: Rocket Lab moved Neutron's debut from year-end 2026 into 2027 (reported as at least the third slip); RKLB closed $55.25 on Oct 15 after a six-session slide of roughly 21%, though Q2 revenue was $234.1M (+62%) on a $2.36B backlog.

Starlink connectivity revenue rose 66% to $4.29B; SpaceX also agreed Oct 8 to buy ~$8B of low-band spectrum (FCC approval pending), and Starship Flight 14 reached orbit for the first time on Sept 28 with 26 Starlink V3 satellites.

tiers.label: Scale Players
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Q2 revenue of $7.81B (+92%) with Starlink connectivity at $4.29B (+66%) on 12M subscribers; Starship reached orbit on Flight 14 (Sept 28) and an ~$8B spectrum purchase (Oct 8, FCC pending) points Starlink Mobile at carriers. Shares closed $148.62 on Oct 15, ~34% below the $225.64 June high.
rows.watch for: Q3 earnings (expected early November) trigger a further 28% of pre-IPO shares becoming sellable, with earlier tranches Oct 9 and Oct 24/26 and another around Dec 8; also Q2 capex of $18.4B against a $541M net loss, and political risk after Starshield restrictions in Ukraine.

rows.angle: Q2 revenue $234.1M (+62%), backlog $2.36B (+137%), ~$2.13B cash, and Q3 revenue guided to $250–265M; the $8B Iridium deal ($27 cash plus stock inside a $67.50–$112.50 collar) is fully funded and guided to close mid-2027.
rows.watch for: Neutron's first launch moved into 2027 on Oct 14 (at least the third slip); shares fell ~21% in six sessions to ~$55 (roughly 65% below the record), Q3 adjusted EBITDA is guided to a $17–23M loss, and FCC review of Iridium remains.

rows.angle: Space and Mission Systems anchored by 18 of the 36 satellites in the SDA's $1.75B Tranche 3 tracking-layer award (July) and the $4.7B PAC-3 propulsion award; shares ~$248.
rows.watch for: Q3 earnings Oct 29 (consensus EPS ~$3.01, revenue ~$5.86B); shares are down ~10.6% since the July beat-and-raise, so the market is not crediting awards yet. Also sits in the Defense sleeve — don't double-count exposure.

tiers.label: Growth / Speculative
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: 13 BlueBirds in orbit with BlueBirds 14–16 now at Cape Canaveral (no launch date announced) and a target of ~45 satellites by early 2027; Berenberg kept Buy, arguing SpaceX's spectrum deal makes AST a natural partner for existing carriers.
rows.watch for: SpaceX's Grain spectrum purchase and Starlink Mobile are direct competition; shares fell from ~$53 (Oct 12) to ~$41 in later quotes, down roughly a quarter year to date, with dilution from earlier convertible raises.

rows.angle: Record ~$1.8B backlog and a reaffirmed $900M–$1B 2026 revenue outlook; market cap only ~$2.4B after the shares fell from ~$14 (Oct 7) to ~$10.8.
rows.watch for: Shares sit near the lower end of a $7.78–$46.75 52-week range with EPS of about −$0.90, ~$259M of net insider selling over 12 months, and backlog conversion into recognized revenue.

rows.angle: Revenue growth of ~58% with a first profitable quarter earlier this year; part of Google's Project Suncatcher prototype (launched Oct 1); Barclays initiated at Equal Weight with a $17 target.
rows.watch for: Shares ~$13.56 versus a $51 May peak and a $10.52 52-week low; dependence on SpaceX rideshare capacity (tightening by 2028) and founder stock sales.

rows.angle: One of 15 NITE STAR vendors (ceiling >$980M, no guaranteed revenue) and awarded two Roll-Out Solar Array wings for Axiom's second station module; shares ~$9.6–10 in the Oct 7–9 window, down ~28% year to date.
rows.watch for: Timelines are years out (Axiom module 2028), $1.15B of net insider selling over 12 months remains unexplained, and the $500M equity raise earlier this year added dilution. Limited fresh company news this week.

private_watchlist.name: Blue Origin
private_watchlist.note: Raised about $10B in July at a reported $130B valuation (Bezos ~$2B, Coatue reportedly leading ~$4B) and on Oct 16 outlined new Florida launch pads, a manufacturing expansion and landing barges to raise New Glenn's flight rate; no confirmed return-to-flight date after the last anomaly.

private_watchlist.name: Firefly Aerospace
private_watchlist.note: No fresh company news found this week; Alpha Block 2's debut was last reported as slipping to Q4 2026, and the cleanroom expansion (Sept 22) is aimed at spacecraft production.

private_watchlist.name: Stoke Space
private_watchlist.note: No new update this week beyond the earlier $1B Series E (total raised $2.3B); Nova Block 2, a fully reusable design, remains targeted for 2029.

bear_case.title: Capital intensity
bear_case.description: Rocket Lab still guides to a $17–23M Q3 adjusted EBITDA loss while funding an $8B Iridium deal; SpaceX spent $18.4B of capex in Q2 against a $541M net loss; Blue Origin needed a $10B raise. Funding is abundant now, but the sector depends on it staying that way.

bear_case.title: Government concentration
bear_case.description: The SDA's Tranche 3 tracking awards ($1.75B across L3Harris and Sierra Space in July) and Redwire's NITE STAR slot (one of 15 vendors, no guaranteed revenue) show how much revenue hangs on a few federal programs. Starshield restrictions in Ukraine also show a single operator's decisions can become a geopolitical issue.

bear_case.title: SpaceX dominance and supply overhang
bear_case.description: SPCX is ~34% below its June high with lockup tranches continuing (a further 28% of pre-IPO shares after Q3 earnings, then another around Dec 8); its ~$8B spectrum purchase and Starlink Mobile put it directly against AST SpaceMobile, and its launch economics keep pressuring rivals' margins.

bear_case.title: Binary mission risk and schedule slips
bear_case.description: Neutron's first launch slipped into 2027 (at least the third delay), AST has 13 satellites in orbit against a ~45 target, and Starship Flight 14 succeeded in orbit but the ship toppled and exploded after splashdown, with ship catch and in-orbit refuelling still unproven. Mid-cap space shares have fallen 50–75% from May highs.

catalysts.title: Starship Flight 14 reaches orbit
catalysts.description: First orbital Starship flight; 26 Starlink V3 satellites deployed, though the ship toppled and exploded after splashdown and one engine shut down early.

catalysts.title: SpaceX agrees ~$8B low-band spectrum purchase
catalysts.description: Acquiring Grain Management's nationwide 800 MHz spectrum, pending FCC approval, to strengthen Starlink Mobile against carriers and direct-to-device rivals.

catalysts.title: Rocket Lab pushes Neutron's debut into 2027
catalysts.description: RKLB closed $55.25 on Oct 15 after a six-session slide of roughly 21%; KeyBanc cut its target to $100 and Clear Street to $105.

catalysts.title: Starshield restrictions in Ukraine hit SpaceX
catalysts.description: Reports of restricted Starshield service disrupting drone operations drew public criticism; SPCX fell 2.3% to $148.62.

catalysts.title: Seraphim: record $20.8B Q3 private investment
catalysts.description: 216 deals at a $9.8M median, with launch and space access drawing $16.4B, largely the Blue Origin round.

catalysts.title: Next SpaceX lockup tranche and L3Harris earnings
catalysts.description: Up to ~328M SPCX shares become eligible around Oct 24/26; L3Harris reports Q3 on Oct 29. SpaceX Q3 earnings, expected early November, unlock the largest block (~28% of pre-IPO shares).

etfs.name: Procure Space
etfs.summary: Pure-play, revenue-weighted (RKLB, PL, ASTS among top holdings); traded ~$42 in mid-October after a ~3% drop on Oct 7, so it has been tracking the weakness in the mid-cap names.

etfs.name: ARK Space Exploration
etfs.summary: Actively managed with broader tech adjacency; ARK has commented that Neutron comes close to Falcon 9 on payload, and the fund's results depend heavily on a handful of high-beta holdings.

etfs.name: SPDR Kensho Final Frontiers
etfs.summary: Equal-weight blend of space, defense and deep-sea names; the defense-adjacent holdings (like L3Harris) cushion it versus pure-plays, though L3Harris itself has lagged since July.

positions.name: Rocket Lab
positions.note: Neutron's debut slipped into 2027 and shares fell ~21% in six sessions to ~$55, but Q2 revenue of $234.1M (+62%) and a $2.36B backlog keep Electron-led fundamentals intact — trimming weight, not the stance.

positions.name: L3Harris
positions.note: 18 of the 36 satellites in the SDA's $1.75B tracking award and the $4.7B PAC-3 propulsion award underpin the backlog, though shares (~$248) are down ~10.6% since July and Q3 earnings land Oct 29. Also sits in the Defense sleeve — don't double-count exposure.

positions.name: AST SpaceMobile
positions.note: 13 BlueBirds in orbit and 14–16 at the Cape with no launch date, but SpaceX's ~$8B spectrum deal makes it a direct rival and shares slid from ~$53 to ~$41 within days — cutting size.

positions.name: Intuitive Machines
positions.note: A ~$1.8B backlog and a $900M–$1B revenue outlook look cheap against a ~$2.4B market cap at ~$10.8, but ~$259M of net insider selling and unproven conversion keep it small.

positions.name: Planet Labs
positions.note: Revenue growth of ~58% and a Google Suncatcher role, yet shares of ~$13.56 sit near a $10.52 low and Barclays' $17 target implies limited upside; rideshare dependence persists.

positions.name: Redwire
positions.note: NITE STAR (one of 15 vendors, no guaranteed revenue) and Axiom solar-array wings add backlog, but $1.15B of net insider selling against a market cap near $1B stays unexplained at ~$9.6–10.

positions.name: SpaceX
positions.note: Starlink at 12M subscribers and Starship reaching orbit are real, but ~$149 is still ~34% below the June peak with 28% of pre-IPO shares unlocking after early-November earnings; waiting for that supply to clear. UK investors wanting indirect exposure can use Scottish Mortgage (SMT, covered on the Baillie Gifford page).

positions.name: Iridium Communications
positions.note: RKLB now trades below the $67.50 low end of the deal collar, so Iridium's value stays tied to Rocket Lab's slide with close not expected until mid-2027 — RKLB remains the cleaner way to express the view.
